title: Unsafe SQL query construction
difficulty_rationale: One module with three query functions; the fixes are standard (parameterised queries, an allow-list for ORDER BY, LIKE escaping) and fully specified.
summary: Repository functions build SQL with string formatting, allowing SQL injection through names, search prefixes and the sort column.
required_behavior: All user-supplied values are passed as bound parameters; no user input is interpolated into SQL text.
search_users(prefix) treats % and _ in the prefix literally (LIKE wildcards are escaped).
order_by is restricted to the allow-list {'name', 'created_at'}; anything else raises ValueError.
Results and return types are unchanged for legitimate input.

acceptance_tests.description: A tautology payload does not return all users.
Stacked/destructive payloads do not modify the database.
% and _ in the prefix are matched literally.
Injection through update_email does not affect other rows.
